params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: start
params.description: A parseable date string defining the earliest returned records. Recommended format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+0000

params.name: end
params.description: A parseable date string defining the last returned records. Recommended format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+0000

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for the appointment clinic

params.name: cancelled
params.description: Filter by cancelled status.

params.name: unavailable
params.description: Unavailable appointments are used to block availability on a schedule, specify to set the filter

params.name: nex_only
params.description: Only show appointments booked via NexHealth API

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Query appointments whose records have updated since the specified datetime in ISO8601 format. Must be a parseable date/time, recommended formats are YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+0000

params.name: created_by
params.description: Query appointments that were created by a specific user

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs: This endpoint books an appointment for the given patient with the given provider at the specified location. When is_guardian is true, the booking is made by a guardian and a patient object with the dependent's details must be provided. Set unavailable to true to create a block instead of a patient appointment.
